type_row: Inter Tight sets display text, and Inter sets reading text and the interface. Lora Italic appears only in quoted lines. The Inter Project Authors made Inter and Inter Tight. Lora comes from The Lora Project Authors, and the authors license all three under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. We built the font files into this page unchanged, so it loads no type from elsewhere. Lora’s license reserves the name “Lora”, so a changed version would need another name. Open a license below to read it in full.
